baseline.statement: Let $U$ be a minimizer at $r\in(0,1)$, and let $m=e(U)$ and $F=F(U)=V(r)$. \begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)] \item $0<F\le h(r)<1$, $m+F<1$, and $r\le m\le\frac14(1+\sqrt{1+8r^3})$.
